items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1962-02-06
items.q: Called Dusty, fine drummer, show man, you know.

ctx.x: He's much older than me, you know. Just true playing in the Pierron band. You see, Bill used to play drums with us, you know, Pierron. Bill, what was that? Bill, Matthews, the trombone player? Uh huh. So when Bill left, I don't know why he left, but anyway, I made Pierron get the old man, see, because he was the style drummer we needed in that band, see.
Who taught him to play? Who?
The old man. I told you, a fellow at the theater, yeah. That's right. Yeah. Called Dusty, fine drummer, show man, you know.
